nodes.text:
HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) cases detected in India.

- Primarily affects young children.

- Symptoms similar to cold/flu: cough, fever, runny nose.

- Most cases mild, but can cause severe illness in some.

- Good hygiene, vaccination (for certain groups), and early treatment
